title: Work feedback feels personal
hypothetical_setup: A manager says a report needs a revision. You interpret it as proof you cannot do the job.
rationale: Separate the observable request from a global identity judgment; still check whether criticism is fair.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Mistake near deadline
hypothetical_setup: You miss a target and want to blame a coworker publicly.
choices: Pause, document the obstacle and ask for a repair plan
rationale: Misdirected aggression is not problem solving; protect others and seek specific evidence.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Invitation after unkind comments
hypothetical_setup: You were mocked in one group and receive a new invitation from a different group.
choices: Assess safety and choose your own boundary
rationale: A protective boundary may be valid; generalization is not always useful.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Apology after betrayal
hypothetical_setup: Someone who hurt you asks to reconnect.
choices: You may decline contact and need not forgive to stay safe
rationale: The book’s forgiveness rhetoric must not override safety, consent or responsibility.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Speak up or stay quiet
hypothetical_setup: At a low-stakes team meeting you have a relevant idea but worry you sound awkward.
choices: Share a concise idea when safe
Stay silent to preserve an image
rationale: Balanced expression can proceed without eliminating all self-awareness.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Response to public critique
hypothetical_setup: An expert points out a genuine problem in your work.
rationale: Confidence is compatible with valid critical feedback.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Message during focused work
hypothetical_setup: A nonurgent alert appears while you finish a task.
choices: Check urgency and decide if it can wait
rationale: Not all notifications require immediate action; urgent messages are an exception.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.

title: Before a presentation
hypothetical_setup: Your mind is racing with the last meeting as you begin another.
choices: Take an optional transition cue and focus on 1 objective
rationale: A quiet cue is an optional attention aid, not a clinical tranquilizer.
privacy_safety: No assessment or diagnosis; opt out at any point. No forced disclosure, forgiveness, or contact.
